summary: Retrieval: mega-text head crowding surfaced by golden set after blavatsky-sd load; golden-check harness was mis-calibrated (top-8 vs prod top-15)
description:
Golden set began failing after the blavatsky-sd (Secret Doctrine, 727 chunks) load. Investigation 2026-08-27/28 against docker postgres (6743 chunks, all embedded).

TWO distinct causes:

A) Mega-text head crowding (the real regression). MAX_PER_TRADITION=3 (retriever.ts:373) is per-TRADITION, not per-text. The 4 biggest omnibus works are each alone in their tradition — blavatsky-sd/theosophy (NEW), plotinus/neoplatonism, secret-teachings/western_esoteric, boehme/christian_mysticism — so each grabs its full 3 head slots. Measured: mega-texts take 7-8 of 15 head slots on failing queries; blavatsky-sd:3 appears in the head of EVERY failing query. Adding blavatsky added a 4th crowder to a 15-slot head, pushing small target texts past the cutoff. No per-TEXT cap exists.

B) Vocabulary mismatch (latent, NOT caused by new text). Golden query uses a term absent from the specific public-domain translation: 'wu wei' -> Legge's 'non-action' (0 body hits in tao-te-ching-legge); 'Nous' -> Mead's 'Mind' (0 in corpus-hermeticum-01). Both legs blind. Would have failed before blavatsky.

Also found: intake pools scale with topK (retriever.ts:77-80, vector topK*poolMult, lexical/graph topK*2), so retrieve(q,8) != retrieve(q,15) truncated — same query returns different heads. golden-check.ts harness ran topK=8 while prod (api/query/route.ts:155) serves 15. FIXED harness default to 15 (golden-check.ts:36, uncommitted working-tree edit) — that recovered kybalion + book-of-dead (harness-only artifacts). Still-failing at K=15: sefer-yetzirah (crowding), corpus-hermeticum + tao-te-ching (vocab).

Candidate directions (not yet decided): per-text cap MAX_PER_TEXT~2; floor intake pools independent of topK; concept_aliases for doctrinal synonyms (wu wei<->non-action, Nous<->Mind); fix/rebaseline the two vocab golden queries.
